notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section, Pub. L. 101–501, title IX, § 918, Nov. 3, 1990, 104 Stat. 1265; Pub. L. 103–252, title IV, § 402(a), May 18, 1994, 108 Stat. 672, established the Federal Council on Children, Youth, and Families, and terminated the Council on Sept. 30, 1998.
